lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: The registration period has closed. If you did not complete your registration before today, you will not be able to vote as a new registrant in this election.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: If you were already registered in a previous cycle, check your polling division assignment on the notice board. That may still be valid.
The door was open every week. It is closed now. The game does not stop. But something permanent has changed.
